### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials
Root: exercise the float-down (doc "Exercising the Rate Lock Commitment Float-Down").
- Hop 1 (state-derived): "A float-down is exercised, and its fee fixed, only once the lock's status reads locked." Record: status `expired`. Write: "Relocking an Expired ..." — "The relock sets the lock back to locked"; tool "One call puts the lock back in locked status."
- Hop 2 (state-derived): "The float-down fee is not worked out until every relock requested on the lock's request log carries its relock fee entry." Record: relock request 1b07e3c3 on the log, no relock fee entry. Write: "Relock Fee Entries" — "One call writes one relock fee entry".
  - Hop 2a (state-derived, on the relock-fee side): "A relock fee is booked only after the lock's record shows the relock, the lock back in locked status with a new expiration date." -> satisfied by hop 1's write.
  - Hop 2b (state-derived): "The relock fee is not fixed until every borrower-borne extension charge on the lock that the appraisal-delay case covers carries its waiver entry." Record: borrower-borne extension 99cb72d9, appraisal completed 12 days after due, no dispute filed, no waiver entry. Write: "Larkspur-Initiated Waivers ..." — "The waiver is one waiver entry naming the lock's most recent borrower-borne extension entry" (applies "when no dispute has been filed against that extension": none filed).
- Order: relock and waiver (either order) -> relock fee -> float-down (user). The waiver must precede the fee (share 0.25 vs 0.5); the fee must precede the float-down (relocked surcharge 0.125 reads it, and the sentence of hop 2).
- Counter-proof "only exercise the float-down": excluded by hop 1's sentence (status expired) and hop 2's (relock request without fee entry); also "Effect of Expiration": "Expiration ends the protection of the locked rate and price. The borrower then floats until relocked."
- Closest alternatives excluded: treat the 10-19 relock request as a fresh lock (one-lock-per-file: "handled ... as an extension, relock, float-down or cancellation of the existing lock"); higher-of pricing (prompt-relock basis, 5 <= 7 lapsed days); full deposit relief (held < 4,453.74); waiver at 12 days or plain per-day valuation (factor docs + loan amount risen); share 0.5 (waiver first); deep-improvement pricing (0.375 < 0.500); refuse for CD cutoff (no CD issued).
